promptTemplate:
You are GPT-6.1 Sol author in a NEW session. Implement the final Japanese operator guidelines requested below. Do NOT start DB/Docker/measurements, delegate, run workflows, commit/push. Read AGENTS.md. All existing benchmark source/evidence and prior accepted doc hashes must remain byte-identical (baseline.json binds them). This is documentation consolidation, not a new benchmark or implementation. Allowed writes ONLY docs/guidelines/mysql.md, docs/guidelines/sql-server.md, docs/README.md. No other edits. Owner handles review artifacts and Git publication.
User verbatim: 最終的に、mysql, sql serverそれぞれで、大部分のmysql table(あらゆるtableの状態を想定) で最適なデータ量取得方法のガイドラインを日本語で作成してcommit,pushせよ
Interpret data volume as whole-table ROW COUNT (business WHERE absent), as established throughout this task. Make this explicit, distinguishing bytes/capacity and app-active/soft-delete-filter counts. Goal: an unfamiliar engineer can select the most efficient safe method for most normal physical tables, handling a broad range of states and combinations. Do not replace ordinary variants with blanket defer. Not universal zero cost, zero schema locks, global optimality, all-settings10% precision, or a safe threshold from N alone. Explain optimality by required precision/freshness/service budget, prioritizing existing exports/reference metadata; exact counts only at prequalified resource-isolated targets; no viable path=>clear fallback/deferral.
Read existing docs/table-count-guideline.md, table-count-calibration.md, sqlserver-table-count-guideline.md and results/reviews/final-all-proof.json, results/sqlserver/owner-proof.json plus underlying relevant JSON and old final acceptance. Use Python to parse allowlisted fields, not giant raw dumps. Existing source and validated mechanisms remain authoritative. Existing MySQL/SQL Server final docs are frozen evidence/detail; new files are the FINAL user-facing selection playbooks. docs/README.md is Japanese index linking both new files first, then old evidence/reproduction details. Do not edit rootREADME (bound by old acceptance).
Each product playbook should be practical ~120-170lines: quick conclusion/algorithm, precision/freshness choice table, comprehensive table-state decision matrix, bounded usable SQL snippets, operator start/stop/end/recovery checklist, short observed precision/cost limits with relative links to immutable evidence/detail. Avoid engine encyclopedia or long workflow implementation chatter. All observed numbers must derive from resultsJSON. No new made-up data or numeric production safety values. If timeout examples use literal budgets, label examples and require owner budgets and driver deadlines BEFORE copy/paste. Per-table/shard result record including UNKNOWN and incomplete totals. New final acceptance record will be results/reviews/final-guidelines/acceptance.json; do not claim completed reviews yet. No doc change after final2role reviews without re-review.
Shared route/state coverage (combine physical, activity, security and acquisition axes; acknowledge combinations and unknown states, not just one huge synthetic grid): known/unknown/0/NULL/missing/denied metadata; empty/tiny/huge; rowwidth80/100/LOB/row overflow; PK exists/absent/string/sparse/skew; no secondary/narrow secondary/multiple/invisible/filtered indexes as applicable; partition whole-object vs partition rows; compression/cache warm/cold/stale or uninitialized stats; heavy updates/INSERT/DELETE/soft-delete and long open transactions; concurrent DDL/rebuild/migration/truncate/object generation; TDE/serverkeys available or unavailable vs application ciphertext/client seed unknown; privileges/RLS/tenant scope; primary/dedicated/shared replica/independent restored copy/none, freshness; logical views vs physical tables, temporary/session-local, nonstandard engine/storage, external/remote/synonyms, temporalcurrent/history, shards/missing targets. Not every axis needs a unique SQL; make SAME normal safe path cover most ordinary variants. Explain unsupported/out-of-scope precise fallback, reference source, or what owner must supply; no error =>0 or blind primary scan.
MySQL: normal InnoDB BASE TABLE across row/index/partition/compression/ciphertext/gap/PK variants uses same approved export/I_S.TABLES.TABLE_ROWS reference and qualified isolated ordinary SELECT COUNT(*), new dedicated non-enlisted non-pooled session RC/RR/autocommit1 initialized before tables. Table metadata scoped by DB/name and engine/type; no expensive discovery scan. row_count0 not confirmed empty. Stats expiry nonzero still cache miss/expiry engine reads, existing0 not silently overwritten; no autoANALYZE/index creation/cacheflush or EXPLAIN ANALYZE. OrdinarySELECT RC/RR row-nonlocking but MDL/undo/resources remain; embedded DML/CTAS/SET count, locking reads/SERIALIZABLE/global/table locks excluded. No COUNT(nullablecol) or PKrangeID surrogate. NonInnoDB/MyISAM/MEMORY/temporary/views: do not automatically use InnoDB count assumptions; inventory/reference from approved source, owner-specific isolated or export route, no production locking count. TABLES metadata omits some temporary/session objects; missing never0. Metadata TABLES whole logical table avoids summing TABLES plus PARTITIONS or duplicates. For exact whole partitioned table COUNT whole table with qualified snapshot, not changing partitions+sum. SQLvisible intPK permits conditional sample prototype only after all provedeligibility; not default and never infer empty/smallness from uncertifiedsample0. Logical restore stats cannot calibrate old productioncache error without matching profile/generation/time. TDE requires SERVER keys even if SQLclient has no seed; backuprestore requireskeyprovision. Initial roughsmallness never productionCOUNT permission. Unknown PK/rowwidth is not reason to abandon ordinaryCOUNT at qualified target.
SQL Server: partition DMV SUM(row_count) index_id IN(0,1), sum all partitions, avoid NCI doublecount; fallback sys.partitions for suitably visible approved scope, reference not exact; permission2022+ VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE +VIEW SECURITY DEFINITION, do not autoGRANT. Optimizer sys.dm_db_stats_properties rows update-time (filteredstats distinct), not currentpartitioncounter; no automaticUPDATESTATS. Initial table/identity/context guard, reference0 not certified empty. Normal disk-based heap/clustered/partitioned/compressed/wide/ciphertext physical tables (and supported diskcolumnstore) keep standard metadata and qualifiedCOUNT_BIG paths, not blanket-defer due lack of every state measurement; columnstore delta/deletes make metadata approximate, no performance/ranking promise from onlyOPENdelta fixture. For specialmemoryoptimized/external/remote/synonym/temp/temporal/view clearly identify count meaning, permissions and owner-approved route instead of blindlyrunninggenericSQL. Temporal current/history are distinct objects and semantics; no automaticuniondoublecount. RLS COUNT visible context differs from wholephysicalmetadata; globalmetadata nevertenant exact. COUNT_BIG avoidsint overflow, star countsNULL rows. ExistingRCSI READCOMMITTED or existingallowedSNAPSHOT only; defaultlockingRC not safe nonlocking path. Do not auto enableproductionRCSI or useNOLOCK/READPAST/TABLOCK/SERIALIZABLE. Require new noambient dedicated session, existingtransaction rejection via @@TRANCOUNT/XACT_STATE, SETIMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF before metadata/count, SNAPSHOT shortexplicittransaction and confirmedzero/end. SETLOCK_TIMEOUT is NOT commandtimeout; driverdeadline+separate cancelowner verifies ownedcurrentSPID/context/login/start, no blindKILLreusedID, rollback/serverend and recovery before nexttable. SchS/SchM, versionstore/tempdb/PVS/longtransactions and CPU/IO remain. AG readable secondary maps diskreads to snapshot but even separatehardware can affectPRIMARY ghostcleanup/space/logreuse; existing approved primary+secondary monitoring, data/logcapacity, data movement/disconnect, stop/recovery budgets required, or independent approved restoredcopy/defer. Replica/backup provisioning themselves budgeted. App ciphertext vs actualAlwaysEncrypted driver unmeasured; no clientkeybypass promise whenservercan'tread.
Use official primary source links for new technical claims; web browsing allowed, primarydocs only. Prior accepted guidelines contain official links. Observation sets/hardware/support boundary explicit (SQL emulated ARMamd64 unsupported, not nativeperformance; both lack100M80/100wideTDEcombo). Use few concise useful observed error examples (MySQL metadata can exceed10%; SQLDMV27positiveobservationsmatched but not bound; optimizerstale rows differentmechanism) or link precision table rather than clutter many timings. Don't make every engineer run lab/Riela to use guideline; final review acceptance is audit appendix, not production prerequisite. Capture acquisition identities/timestamps/snapshotGTIDorLSN/freshness/precisionkind/unknownreason/budget/end status/missing shards; no global current exact claim across separate snapshots.
Return SMALL structured output: status, files, hashes, unresolvedMaterialIssues. No test mirror boilerplate; local link/hash checks permitted, noDB/Docker.
